comparison.summary: How PkgLens maps to the two TrueAncestor tools (PKG Repacker + SELF Resigner).
comparison.outOfScopeNote: The out-of-scope items all need Sony's private signing keys, which PkgLens never uses.

features.name: Repack Pkg
features.description: Replace a file → Save As (unsigned rebuild)

features.name: Resign to NON-DRM EBOOT — DEX/OFW
features.description: OFW signature check needs debug signing keys

features.name: Resign to NPDRM EBOOT — DEX/OFW
features.description: Same — signing keys, out of scope

features.name: Output Method
features.description: fSELF output supports settable firmware and control flags plus RPCS3, CEX CFW, DEX compatibility analysis, and HEN target profiles; signed capability flags remain unavailable

features.name: Compress Data
features.description: Beneficial fSELF segments are zlib-compressed automatically; incompressible or unsafe layouts stay plain

beyondSummary: Beyond TrueAncestor, PkgLens adds a full inspector GUI, integrity verification, EDAT/SDAT decryption, platform exports, library automation, target-aware conversion, structured JSON output, and cross-platform support.

beyond.title: Package inspector GUI
beyond.description: Folder tree, file list, search/filter, recent history, and a built-in image, text, or hex viewer.

beyond.title: Integrity `verify`
beyond.description: Structural bounds, header SHA-1, header AES-CMAC, signatures, and post-operation verification.

beyond.title: EDAT / SDAT decrypt
beyond.description: SDAT keyless and EDAT via RAP or free key, including compressed golden-vector and block-integrity coverage.

beyond.title: SELF header inspect
beyond.description: Reads program type, key revision, ELF header, segment compression, and NPDRM identity without decrypting.

beyond.title: Cross-platform
beyond.description: Avalonia GUI and .NET CLI on Windows, macOS, and Linux.

beyond.title: Scriptable output
beyond.description: Structured `--json` output across CLI inspection and mutation commands.

beyond.title: PlayStation exports
beyond.description: Guided PS1 and PS2 Classics workflows, PSP PBP/ISO/CSO export, and Vita app/update/DLC/theme export.

beyond.title: Library automation
beyond.description: Resumable batch jobs, package classification, matching, duplicate detection, and organization.

beyond.title: Safe conversion guidance
beyond.description: Operation preflight, automatic key/RAP discovery, firmware analysis, and target compatibility reports.

footer.text: The EDAT LZ path is checked against a range-coded compressed golden vector and expected plaintext, while compressed fSELF segments are rebuilt only when beneficial and byte-exactly recoverable.

Firmware-target profiles, automatic fSELF compression, resumable batch/catalog workflows, and PS1, PS2, PSP, and Vita package workflows are available from the GUI, with relevant operations also exposed through the CLI.
README tables, this HTML report, GUI feature descriptions, and the CLI tagline come from this manifest; CI rejects stale generated output.

guiDescriptions.HomeIntro: Keyless PS3 / PSP / PSVita package and EBOOT tools. Each tool is tagged with the file it works on and where its output runs.
guiDescriptions.OpenPackage: Browse, list, search, view, and extract a package.
guiDescriptions.ScanFolder: Catalog and classify every .pkg in a directory.
guiDescriptions.BatchCenter: Audit, classify, verify, extract, export, or CFW-convert a package folder with resumable jobs.
guiDescriptions.PackageOrganizer: Find duplicates and older updates, then preview a PS3 / PSP / Vita library layout.
guiDescriptions.GameFolderInfo: Read a content folder's PARAM.SFO and executable metadata.
guiDescriptions.KeyLicenseAudit: Find required keys, SELF revisions, licenses, missing RAPs, and unsupported encryption.
guiDescriptions.PackFolder: Build a streaming package from a content folder.
guiDescriptions.PackPageIntro: Build a package from a content folder. Fields are pre-filled from PARAM.SFO where possible.
guiDescriptions.TargetCompatibility: Check RPCS3, CEX CFW, DEX, or HEN compatibility before rebuilding.
guiDescriptions.ConvertCfw: Process embedded EBOOT, SELF, and SPRX files, resolve RAPs, fake-sign them, and rebuild a verified package copy.
guiDescriptions.ExportPsp: Locate EBOOT.PBP and export it or decrypt its disc image in one step.
guiDescriptions.ExportPs1: Resolve licenses, preserve metadata, and reconstruct single- or multi-disc images.
guiDescriptions.ExportPs2: Resolve the RAP, verify and decrypt ISO.BIN.ENC, then optionally rebuild a CFW/HEN package copy.
guiDescriptions.ExportVita: Identify app, update, DLC, or theme content and create the correct Vita directory tree.
guiDescriptions.InspectSelf: Read type, key revision, firmware, controls, and segment compression.
guiDescriptions.DecryptSelf: Decrypt EBOOT.BIN or .self to a plaintext ELF.
guiDescriptions.FakeSignSelf: Create a compressed CFW-ready fSELF from a plain ELF.
guiDescriptions.PatchFirmware: Lower a verified firmware requirement and rebuild a fake-signed copy.
guiDescriptions.AnalyzeFirmware: Scan every EBOOT, SELF, and SPRX; report the highest requirement and verified patch support.
guiDescriptions.BytePatch: Apply hex find/replace or an at-offset edit.
guiDescriptions.DecryptEdat: Decrypt and integrity-check an NPDRM EDAT or SDAT file.
guiDescriptions.DecryptPageIntro: Decrypt an NPDRM data file. Licensed EDATs resolve RAPs automatically from the library.
guiDescriptions.ManageKeys: Review bundled keys, import an override, and configure RAP discovery.
guiDescriptions.VerifyPackage: Check header authentication, signatures, decrypted item tables, and structural bounds.
guiDescriptions.DexLimitation: DEX compatibility can be analyzed, but genuine DEX/OFW SELF resigning requires Sony signing keys and remains out of scope.

cliSummary: pkglens — inspect, verify, extract, convert, and rebuild PS3, PSP, and PSVita packages
